# Salman Yousufzai, Freelance SEO Consultant

> Senior SEO specialist based in Karachi, Pakistan, with 5 years in SEO and 8 years in digital marketing, working remotely with businesses across the United States. Offers SEO services, local SEO and Google Business Profile management, technical SEO audits, AI search optimization (GEO and AEO), SEO content writing, SEO web development and white label SEO for agencies. Every project starts with a free SEO review and a fixed quote.

## Pages

- [Home](https://theseospecialist.netlify.app/): Freelance SEO consultant for US businesses, with services, documented results and two free tools.
- [SEO Services](https://theseospecialist.netlify.app/services/): Monthly SEO, local SEO, technical SEO audits, AI search optimization (GEO), SEO content writing, SEO web development and white label SEO.
- [Local SEO Services](https://theseospecialist.netlify.app/local-seo/): Local SEO services for US service businesses: Google Business Profile optimization, citations, reviews and local pages that bring calls and visits.
- [Technical SEO Services](https://theseospecialist.netlify.app/technical-seo/): Technical SEO services: crawling, indexing, Core Web Vitals, schema and site architecture fixed by a hands-on technical SEO consultant.
- [SEO Audit Services](https://theseospecialist.netlify.app/seo-audit/): SEO audit services that find what holds your site back: technical, on-page, content, competitor and backlink analysis with a prioritized fix plan.
- [AI Search Optimization](https://theseospecialist.netlify.app/ai-search-optimization/): AI search optimization (GEO and AEO) so Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and other AI assistants can find, understand and cite your business.
- [SEO Case Studies](https://theseospecialist.netlify.app/results/): Six anonymized case studies with figures from Google Search Console and Google Business Profiles.
- [Free SEO Checker](https://theseospecialist.netlify.app/seo-checker/): Audits a live page for meta title, meta description, canonical tag, H1, meta robots, schema markup, Open Graph tags, image alt text, robots.txt, XML sitemap and Core Web Vitals, and explains each SEO term.
- [Free AI Visibility Checker](https://theseospecialist.netlify.app/ai-visibility-checker/): Tests whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Google AI Overviews can reach, read and cite a page: robots.txt rules for 13 AI crawlers (including GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot), firewall blocks, nosnippet, JavaScript-only content, answer-first structure, schema and llms.txt.
- [SEO Blog](https://theseospecialist.netlify.app/blog/): Plain-English guides to SEO, GEO and content.
- [How to Perform a Technical SEO Audit, Step by Step](https://theseospecialist.netlify.app/blog/how-to-perform-a-technical-seo-audit/): A step-by-step technical SEO audit: crawling, indexing, canonicals, speed, mobile and schema, plus how to prioritize what you find.
- [Technical SEO vs On-Page SEO: Understanding the Difference](https://theseospecialist.netlify.app/blog/technical-seo-vs-on-page-seo/): Technical SEO vs on-page SEO in plain English: what each covers, real examples, a side-by-side table and which to fix first on your site.
- [How to Improve Website Crawlability and Indexability](https://theseospecialist.netlify.app/blog/improve-crawlability-and-indexability/): Why Google can't crawl or index some pages, and how to fix it: robots.txt, noindex, canonicals, sitemaps, internal links and rendering.
- [Common Technical SEO Issues That Affect Website Rankings](https://theseospecialist.netlify.app/blog/common-technical-seo-issues/): The 12 technical SEO issues I find most often on small business sites, why each one hurts rankings and how serious it is, with a quick table.
- [Local SEO for Small Businesses: A Practical Guide](https://theseospecialist.netlify.app/blog/local-seo-for-small-businesses/): A practical local SEO guide for small businesses: how Google ranks local results, what to do first, a 90-day plan and the mistakes to avoid.
- [Google Business Profile Optimization Best Practices](https://theseospecialist.netlify.app/blog/google-business-profile-optimization/): Google Business Profile optimization best practices: categories, services, photos, posts, reviews and the guideline mistakes that get profiles suspended.
- [How to Measure Local SEO Performance](https://theseospecialist.netlify.app/blog/measure-local-seo-performance/): How to measure local SEO performance: the Business Profile, Search Console and Analytics metrics to track monthly, plus a simple report template.
- [How Google AI Overviews Affect Organic Search](https://theseospecialist.netlify.app/blog/google-ai-overviews-organic-search/): How Google AI Overviews change organic search: which searches trigger them, what happens to clicks, how to measure it and how to get cited.
- [What Is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)?](https://theseospecialist.netlify.app/blog/what-is-geo-generative-engine-optimization/): GEO explained in plain English: how AI Overviews and ChatGPT choose sources, and 7 steps to make your business the one they cite.
- [How to Build an SEO Content Strategy](https://theseospecialist.netlify.app/blog/seo-content-strategy/): How to build an SEO content strategy step by step: research, search intent, topic clusters, a publishing plan and how to measure results.

## Documented results (client names withheld)

- Marine retailer, Florida: organic clicks grew from 48 to 635 in one quarter after an audit was implemented.
- Home improvement brand, Manhattan: 326K impressions from a standing start, including 12.2K AI Overview impressions.
- Restaurant group, Florida: direction requests up 600.1% year over year (Google's own calculation).
- Coffee brand, Florida: 8.12K clicks at a 6.9% click-through rate on 118K impressions over six months.
- Smart home installer: PageSpeed 97 mobile and 100 desktop, and a crawl with zero issues.
- Five Google Business Profiles combined: 445K+ profile views, 15.8K direction requests, 14.0K website clicks and 4.0K calls.
- This website: Google PageSpeed Insights 100 performance on desktop and 97 on mobile, 100 SEO on both (October 2026).
